powertrain.label: Powertrain
powertrain.headline: Chassis and battery, built to endure
powertrain.copy: A reinforced frame carries the motor, battery, and suspension as one rigid unit — engineered to endure diverse terrain and rigorously tested for daily commercial duty.
powertrain.alt: Neptune three-wheeler chassis, battery, and suspension layout

interior.label: Interior
interior.headline: A cabin built around the driver
interior.copy: A driver-first layout with an adjustable seat, digital instrument cluster, and USB charging — ergonomic touches that make a full shift behind the wheel comfortable, not just possible.
interior.alt: Neptune three-wheeler cabin and seating layout, viewed from above

exterior.label: Exterior
exterior.headline: One structure, start to finish
exterior.copy: Every panel and support is engineered as part of a single structure — confident styling built to stand out on the route and stand up to daily commercial use, mile after mile.
exterior.alt: Neptune three-wheeler full-body structure, isometric view

Cargo.title: Got cargo? No problem!
Cargo.intro: Neptune switches between passenger and cargo mode in moments, so one vehicle covers both jobs. Fold the seats back for a generous, secure load area, or keep them up for a comfortable ride with plenty of legroom — either way, it's built for a full day's work.

Charging.title: Charging
Charging.intro: Recharge with confidence. Say goodbye to range anxiety with fast, flexible charging options that fit your day.
